name: blueground
description: Search Blueground furnished apartments in cities around the world, see home details, and get the exact total price for given dates.

interface.longDescription:
Find a furnished Blueground apartment for your stay, in cities around the world.

Search by city or neighbourhood, or near a place you name (a hospital, university, station or landmark), with optional dates, number of bedrooms, budget and amenities. Look up the details of a home (size, floor, amenities such as parking or in-unit laundry, availability), and get the exact total price for your dates, including all fees, taxes and deposit, as shown on theblueground.com.

Useful for people relocating for work, studies or a medical rotation, and for anyone who needs a fully furnished home for a few months.

Limitations: the minimum stay depends on the city, and it does not cover hotels. It is read-only: it cannot book, hold, cancel or change a booking. To book, follow the link to the home's page on theblueground.com, with your dates already filled in.
defaultPrompt: Furnished 1-bedroom in New York for 3 months from March 1
Apartment near Columbia University for a semester
Pet-friendly studio in Dubai for 6 months

positive.description: Search homes in a city with dates, size and budget
positive.prompt: I'm moving to New York for 3 months, from February 1 to May 1, 2027. Can you find me a furnished 1-bedroom with Blueground under $7,000 a month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_homes with New York, both dates, 1 bedroom and a $7,000 maximum. Lists available homes with their code (e.g. NYC-643), neighbourhood, monthly rent for those dates and a link to the home's page on theblueground.com with the dates filled in.

positive.description: Search homes near a named public place
positive.prompt: I'll be doing a medical rotation at Mount Sinai Hospital in Manhattan from January 10 to April 10, 2027. Any furnished 1-bed nearby?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_homes with New York, near Mount Sinai Hospital, the dates and 1 bedroom. Returns homes sorted by distance, showing each home's distance from the hospital, monthly rent and link.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Blueground home NYC-643: size, floor, and whether pets are allowed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_home_details for NYC-643. Answers with its size (650 sq ft) and floor (6th). The home's details do not list pets as allowed, so it says it cannot confirm pets are allowed instead of guessing. Does not invent amenities that are not listed.

positive.description: Get the exact total price for a stay
positive.prompt: How much would Blueground home NYC-1241 cost in total from March 1 to June 1, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_stay_quote for NYC-1241 with those dates. Gives the total for the stay including all fees, taxes and deposit, identical to the total on the linked theblueground.com page, and the link with the dates filled in. Does not recalculate or split the total.

positive.prompt: Pet-friendly furnished studio in Dubai for 6 months starting January 1, 2027. What's available on Blueground?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_homes with Dubai, both dates, studio and the pets-allowed amenity. Lists matching studios with code, neighbourhood, monthly rent and link.

negative.description: Hotel stays are out of scope (Blueground offers furnished apartments, not hotels)
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Rome for 2 nights next weekend.

negative.description: Booking is not supported (read-only); the plugin should not claim to book, and may share the quote and booking link instead
negative.prompt: Book Blueground home NYC-643 for me from February 1 to May 1, 2027.

negative.description: Cancelling a booking is not supported (read-only)

review.commerce_description: Read-only discovery: search, home details and prices. Bookings and payments happen on theblueground.com, not in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: Blueground homes are available in cities around the world, minimum stay depends on the city; website name corrected to theblueground.com.
